mentions.name: Dots Journal
mentions.description: This iOS app is a privacy-focused lifestyle tracker that logs events as 'dots' on a simple spreadsheet-like grid, revealing patterns over time. It was built to track migraines and contributing factors, and an upcoming release adds visualizations, charts, and on-device analysis to surface insights.
mentions.problem: The builder suffers from migraines and wanted a dead simple way to log when they happen along with any contributing factors, to identify triggers.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Dots Journal, a privacy focused lifestyle tracker for iOS.

https://dotsjournal.app

I’ve been suffering from migraines for the past few years and wanted a dead simple way to log when they happen, as well as any other contributing factors I could think of. Inspired by the simplicity of spreadsheets, I built a grid of events, and as you tap on cells, you log “dots”. Those dots, over time, reveal patterns.

mentions.name: Dots Journal
mentions.description: This iOS app tracks daily events and stats as simple dots — such as cups of coffee, supplements taken, sleep quality, and migraines — like a digital bullet journal. It visualizes all the dots together to reveal patterns and correlations, which has helped the author significantly reduce migraine occurrences.
mentions.problem: Existing tracking apps were overly complicated; the author wanted a simpler way to narrow down migraine triggers after experiencing migraines for months.
mentions.audience: People who want simple daily tracking of events and stats, such as migraine sufferers narrowing down triggers
mentions.source_excerpt: It’s an iOS app to help tracking events and stats about my day as simple dots. How many cups of coffee? Did I take my supplements? How did I sleep? Did I have a migraine? Think of it like a digital bullet journal.

evidence.value: It’s an iOS app to help tracking events and stats about my day as simple dots. How many cups of coffee? Did I take my supplements? How did I sleep? Did I have a migraine? Think of it like a digital bullet journal.

mentions.name: Dots Journal
mentions.description: A digital bullet journal iOS app for tracking events and habits: users set up rows of events to track and tap to log when each happens, helping surface triggers for issues like migraines and sleep problems and show how lifestyle choices affect wellbeing. It already helped the builder identify and minimize migraine triggers, is entering beta with a full release planned by year end, and is built with SwiftUI.
mentions.problem: Migraine medications are expensive and come with side effects, and the health system wasn't helpful in diagnosing why migraines occur; the app aims to help users identify and avoid triggers before they strike.
mentions.audience: People trying to understand how lifestyle choices impact their wellbeing, such as migraine sufferers and people diagnosing sleep problems.
mentions.source_excerpt: Sort of like a digital bullet journal. You setup some rows of events you want to track, then just tap for when/if that events happens. It’s already helped me spot certain triggers for my migraines, which I can now minimize.

evidence.value: Sort of like a digital bullet journal. You setup some rows of events you want to track, then just tap for when/if that events happens. It’s already helped me spot certain triggers for my migraines, which I can now minimize.
